shared_elements: banded horizontal elements across the body/garment
justification: Both depict human-like figures with elaborate headgear and incised patterning, and A includes a prominent disc motif while B has ornamented banded garments, but these are generic correspondences. A is a massive block-like figure carved in the round with abstract, schematic spirals, discs and near-illegible surface signs, whereas B is a flat relief panel with two naturalistically proportioned bearded figures in profile facing each other, one holding a bowl and gesturing, with carefully rendered curled hair, fringed robes and weapons — no shared specific motif or relationship.
